prompt:
A desktop landing page for Katharo Cleaning, a premium cleaning company in Romania, rendered edge to edge as a finished website screen with crisp readable Romanian text, no browser window, device or desk around it.

The visitor, a homeowner or an office manager, must decide whether to trust Katharo inside their space and ask for a fixed-price quote.

What leads: the lift of a 1930s Bucharest interwar apartment block. Across the top of the page sits a wide semicircular gold brass floor-indicator dial with a needle; its numbered floor marks are the page's sections: "P Recepție", "1 Locuințe", "2 Birouri", "3 Depozite", "4 După renovare", "5 Regulile casei". Under it, the open lift cage with a geometric gold grille frames a photograph of a spotless interwar lobby and staircase: cream terrazzo floor, gold handrail, black lacquer walls. Headline over the black band: "Curat, ca la prima intrare." with one line: "Curățenie pentru case, birouri și depozite. Preț fix, în scris, înainte de lucrare." The working quote starter sits like the lift's call panel: a field "Tip spațiu", a field "Suprafață (m²)" and a round gold button "Cere oferta fixă". The next section begins below on cream as floor 1, "Locuințe și apartamente", with its short description.

Frame: top left the logo, a gold high-contrast serif letter K with a small four-point sparkle, next to the wordmark KATHARO CLEANING; navigation "Servicii", "Cum lucrăm", "Întrebări"; at the right "Solicită o ofertă".

Visual law, pinned brand palette and nothing else: black lacquer with polished gold for the dark areas, warm cream with bronze for the light areas; no green, no other hues. Cream terrazzo with bronze and black chips. Building lettering in a geometric Art Deco display face, reading text in a quiet sans. The signature is the gold floor-indicator dial as navigation.
